Yes, that works the way I'd hope. I typed PASTA in all caps and it still pulled up my pasta recipe — the capitalization didn't trip it up, which was one of my worries. And it narrowed the list the moment I started typing, without me hitting a button. Searching across the titles and descriptions is right, and the card layout makes it easy to see what's left after filtering. The assumptions feel good to me.

One thing I want to make sure we get to as search grows: I also keep notes and the web addresses themselves on these, so eventually I'd want a search to look through those too, not just the title and description. But that's fine to come back to — for what you're showing here, this is right.
